alphaMapping.directionEstablishedBy: Frame0 interior is a uniform 900-pixel diamond of127; exterior254. Single-neighbor frames reduce values toward2 on one edge; FOG retains64..127 in the same footprint. YAML declares a dedicated TSShroudPalette shared by shroud/fog.
alphaMapping.normalizationRationale: Assign the full-shroud frame0 diamond to full opacity and the unused exterior254 to transparent, preserving increasing source intensity and native gradients without synthesized shapes.
alphaMapping.limitations: Neither original SHP nor retained YAML contains a native numeric alpha LUT. Full-opacity endpoint and linear normalization are explicit presentation inferences, not a recovered native palette. No unittem/cameo palette is used. Raw indices remain exact; FOG opacity is encoded by its larger original intensities, with no extra alpha multiplier.

orientationLimitation: Directions name the PNG screen axes only: +x right,+y down. Bits name the side/corner where original opacity decreases. World/map neighbor offsets and mask construction belong to the consumer; no engine code was inspected.
maskZeroPolicy: No frame carries mask0 in the supplied DATA map. For a clear mask0 consumer may explicitly select original clear frame47; this is a consumer policy, not another source frame-map entry.
duplicateMaskPolicy: Preserve both255 variants. frameByMask chooses0 (full diamond),47 remains explicit clear variant. They differ at900 original pixels.
drawing: Regions already contain the full original60x30 canvas. Preserve orientation and nearest sampling; do not apply sourceRect again. Empty records48..95 have no atlas regions or raster pixels.
pixelPolicy: Every non-padding atlas pixel is the original indexed pixel at the original location transformed only to black with disclosed alpha. No redrawing, resampling, fabricated mask shape or placeholder pixels.

previews.description: Contact sheet composites the source alpha pixels over a checkerboard for visibility. Row-major shroud0..47 then fog0..47. It is a preview only; atlas.png retains black RGBA with transparent padding.
